steps.title: 01-signin: Sign in to EspoCRM at http://127.0.0.1:8097/ with username admin and password {{env:APP_PASSWORD}} (type the password text exactly as given). After signing in, confirm you are logged in as admin.

02-find: Go to the Opportunities list. Find all opportunities whose Name starts with 'Seed:' (use the list search/filter if helpful). Report the exact full names of every such opportunity, exactly as shown on screen, and the total count.

03-create: Create a new Opportunity in EspoCRM with these exact values: Name = '{{runid}} Bench Opportunity'; Account = the account named 'Bench Account' (this is a link field — you must actually select the record 'Bench Account' from the suggestions dropdown or the select dialog, not just type the text; note other accounts have similar names, so pick the exact one); Stage = 'Negotiation'; Amount = 12500 (leave currency as the default); Close Date = 2026-12-31; Assigned User = the user named 'Bench Assignee' (also a link field — actually select the user record 'Bench Assignee' from the suggestions or select dialog, not just typed text); Description = text that includes the runid '{{runid}}' (e.g. 'Bench opportunity for run {{runid}}'). Save the record. Then open the created opportunity's detail page and report: its name, the linked account shown, stage, amount, close date, assigned user, and the description text.

04-edit: On the opportunity '{{runid}} Bench Opportunity' detail page ({{03-create.url}}), if the page is currently in edit mode, cancel/close the edit without saving so you are on the read-only detail view. Then use the Stream panel on that page to post a message whose text includes the runid '{{runid}}' (e.g. 'Bench note for run {{runid}}'). Submit the post. Then report the exact text of the post as it now appears in the record's Stream panel.

05-verify: Verify the opportunity '{{runid}} Bench Opportunity' at {{03-create.url}} on its read-only detail page. Report exactly as shown: (1) the record Name, (2) the linked Account, (3) the Stage, (4) the Amount with currency, (5) the Close Date — and to confirm the year, open the field's edit (pencil) or the record's Edit view and report the exact close date value held in the form (e.g. 12/31/2026 or 2026-12-31), then cancel without saving; (6) the Assigned User, (7) the Description text, (8) whether the Stream panel contains a post including the text '{{runid}}' and its exact text, and (9) the record ID as it appears in the page address after #Opportunity/view/.
